name: Roasted Japanese Sweet Potato (Flesh Only, Skin Discarded)
whyItWorks: Creamy, naturally sweet white-fleshed Satsumaimo sweet potato baked until buttery soft with the peel strictly removed. Gentle soluble starch that is easy to digest during flares.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Bake whole sweet potato at 400°F until knife slips through easily. Split open, discard all skin completely, and eat only the soft fork-tender interior flesh with sea salt.
